heading: Complex Urban Layouts and High-Density Housing

blocks.html: Based on user research, I found that delivery in urban areas of Japan is challenging due to the complex urban layout and high population density. These areas often feature buildings with multiple rooms, and several families often rent in the same residence. This situation makes delivery more difficult because delivery drivers frequently handle multiple packages for similar address, which can easily lead to delivery mistakes.
